text: #261's pinned acceptance test TestPlumbingReviewsRetryAndReportProviderExhaustion gives its exhausted case's build 3 seconds, not 300 ms. The build spends about 200 ms staging and checking before its review starts, so under load the deadline sometimes killed the stand-in Codex before it reported its capacity error, and the test failed with no provider failure to see: 5 of 20 runs on the merger's machine. Three seconds still ends inside the review's first wait, a minute over 12, so the case checks the same thing: a run whose provider stays unavailable fails as unavailable, with the provider's last error. It passed 20 of 20 runs with ten CPU hogs running. It changes a ratified test, so it waits for @gitdek's ratification.
